root.name: Ruy Lopez: Central Countergambit
root.moves: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Bb5 a6 4. Ba4 Nf6 5. O-O d5

overview: Against the Morphy Defense Black plays 5...d5 instead of the usual ...Be7. After 6.exd5 e4 or 6.Nxe5 White wins a pawn and the play is sharp. Black hopes for activity but gets little return, and the line is regarded as unsound.

white_ideas.idea: Take the pawn with exd5 or Nxe5

black_ideas.idea: Win back the pawn with tactics

character.notes: Black plays for activity at a cost of a pawn.

gambit.notes: Black gives the d-pawn and White keeps it.

character.reason: Black sacrifices a pawn for activity in an open position.

gambit.reason: Black offers the d- or e-pawn with 5...d5 and White can keep it.

soundness.reason: White just takes a pawn and has no big risks.

structure.reason: The centre pawns come off straight away.

level.reason: Dubious, so not Beginner, and the tactics are simple.

plans.reason: Black's compensation is open lines and development.
